title: Idle clock · 64 × 64 at 1 Hz
brief: Date and time after more than five minutes of idle status and phase. Three original pixel-character directions, previewed at one update per second; physical performance is not measured here.

artboards.title: Perimeter parade
artboards.tradeoff: Three tiny walkers orbit all four edges. A playful frame, with smaller date and seconds.

artboards.title: Bottom promenade
artboards.tradeoff: Oversized stacked hours and minutes, larger seconds, and an upright parade confined to the lower edge.

artboards.title: Gentleman after hours
artboards.tradeoff: An original miniature gentleman above a conventional clock, with one discreet border walker.
